data.name: Usinas Itamarati
data.description: Usinas Itamarati S.A. (UISA) is a large Brazilian biorefinery in Nova Olímpia, Mato Grosso that produces sugar, ethanol, cogenerated electricity, animal feed and yeast from sugarcane and corn. It is listed as a carbon removal supplier on Puro.earth, where its facility has passed third-party audits and received CORC issuances, but CDR is a small adjacent activity alongside its core sugar/ethanol/energy business.
